title: Fish
query_adaptations: Translate any-of?/not-any-of? into anchored match?/not-match? alternatives without removing conditions.
Map modern capture names to established Runestone names; remove spell/nospell editor controls.
source:
function greet
  echo "hello"
  test 1 -eq 1
end
# note

additional_cases.source:
function greet --argument-names name
  set -l values (seq 1 3)
  for value in $values
    printf '%s %s\n' "$name" $value | string upper
  end
  if test -f "$HOME/.config/fish/config.fish"
    echo yes >&2
  end
end
